sources.snippet: Meta Muse Glimmer Meta Superintelligence Labs Open Weights Local AI Quick answer: Meta Muse Glimmer, released on 10 August 2026, is a 30-billion-parameter open-weight model under Apache 2.0 built for local agentic work. Meta's quantised releases target 24GB or 32GB devices, while full precision targets 64GB.

sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.
